AlwaysTask.stop.description: Stop future execution of this updater and remove its AbortSignal listener. Calling stop again has no effect.
notes: This does not destroy the entity or undo mutations made by previous callbacks. reset only resets counters and delay; it does not turn a stopped task back on.

AlwaysTask.pause.description: Mark this updater paused while retaining its running state and accumulated timing. Other scene tasks can continue.

AlwaysTask.resume.description: Clear the paused flag. A stopped task remains stopped because resume does not change isRunning.

AlwaysTask.reset.description: Reset invocation count, elapsed time and interval accumulation, and restore the configured nonnegative initial delay.
notes: The paused/running flags and callback closure state are retained. Reset your simulation state separately when replay should begin from its original values.

Entity.invalidateTransform.description: Mark cached world transforms dirty, update their version and propagate that invalidation through children.
notes: The attached composer is invalidated when the world transform becomes dirty. The parent anchor is also invalidated so bounds-dependent alignment can be measured again. This is transform-cache invalidation, not a replacement for rebuilding changed geometry.

Entity.getGroupLocalAABB.description: Measure this entity and its visible descendants in the root entity’s local coordinate system.
Entity.getGroupLocalAABB.returnsDescription: A new AABB enclosing transformed descendant bounds. An empty group falls back to a point at local origin.
notes: The root’s own transform and offset are excluded; descendants contribute their transforms and offsets. Invisible branches are skipped. Use world bounds when comparing independently transformed objects in a scene.

Entity.forSubNodes.description: Visit this entity first, then recursively visit children in their array order.

parameters.fn: Synchronous callback receiving each Entity, including this root. Visibility does not filter this traversal.

notes: The method returns no cancellation handle and does not wait for an async callback. Avoid mutating the children array during traversal unless you account for the resulting visit order.

Entity.forSuperNodes.description: Walk from this entity up its parent chain toward the root.

parameters.fn: Synchronous callback receiving each visited Entity.
parameters.includeSelf: Visit this entity before its ancestors; defaults to true. False begins with the parent.

notes: A detached entity with includeSelf false produces no visits. This walks ownership parents, not class inheritance.

Material.setShadingStyle.description: Select the material’s shading model and mark its packed GPU data changed.

parameters.v: A ShadingStyle value or its numeric representation. Use the enum for a readable choice.

notes: Choosing a style does not configure all its parameters. Use setGooch or setCel to set the corresponding values together.

Material.setGooch.description: Select Gooch shading and set its warm/cool coefficients.
notes: Creates a GoochShading module with its own warm and cool values. Assign material.shading directly to use the module API.

Material.setCel.description: Select cel shading and set lighting bands and rim contribution.

parameters.bands: Band-count parameter for quantized lighting; defaults to 3.

notes: Creates a CelShading module with its own band and rim settings. Assign material.shading directly to configure and update the module.

Material.clone.description: Create a material copy through Material.copy.
Material.clone.returnsDescription: A separate Material containing the copied packed values and set-mask state. Later changes to its numeric material data do not mutate the original.

Scene.addAnim.description: Add prepared animations to the scene queue, or defer insertion until the next update if the composer is currently rendering.

parameters.anim: One or more Animation instances. This queue operation does not apply play options or provide a completion promise.

notes: Use Scene.play for ordinary awaited choreography. Direct queue management requires handling the animation’s preparation, completion and cancellation yourself.

Scene.removeAnim.description: Queue removal of one animation and request a frame.

parameters.anim: The scheduled Animation instance to detach on an update.

notes: Queue removal alone does not settle an awaited completion promise. Use the animation’s stop/cancellation behavior when interrupting a play.

Scene.updateTime.description: Advance this scene’s millisecond clock using a supplied delta or frame_interval, scaled by timeScale.

parameters.dt: Optional unscaled delta in milliseconds. When omitted, uses the scene’s frame_interval.

notes: The scaled value becomes scene.dt and is added to scene.time. This updates timing; it does not by itself step animations or submit a frame.

Scene.update.description: Step one scene frame, processing updater phases, scheduled animations and child entities in a defined order.
notes: The order is pre updaters → queued animation insertion/removal → animations → update updaters → entities → post updaters. Post is suitable for a camera following an entity that just moved.

Render and compute queues are cleared at the beginning of the update. Produce this frame’s commands from the appropriate update path; adding them once before a later update does not retain them forever.

Scene.continue.description: Request ten frame updates and invalidate the scene. This requests rendering activity; it does not clear isPaused or resume awaited choreography.

Scene.clearColor.description: Set the attached composer’s clear color. Before attachment, this method currently does nothing.

parameters.color: Background Color; the composer stores its RGB premultiplied by alpha.

notes: The background belongs to the composer shared by its scenes. This method does not directly invalidate an otherwise idle composer; request a frame after a live background change.

Scene.setBackgroundColor.description: Set the attached composer’s background through the same clearColor operation.

parameters.color: Background Color whose alpha is applied during composer storage.

notes: No composer means no change. The method has the same attachment and invalidation constraints as Scene.clearColor.

Scene.isFinished.description: Check that the animation queue and requested frame-update count are empty.
Scene.isFinished.returnsDescription: True when neither of those has remaining work.
notes: This is not a promise that every application timer, asset request, updater or async run continuation has finished. Choose an explicit duration/completion boundary for video capture.

Scene.enableFrameFeedback.description: Enable frame feedback on this scene’s initialized renderer.
Scene.enableFrameFeedback.returnsDescription: The FrameFeedbackFeature for configuring retained image history.
notes: This needs renderer attachment. Feedback is image accumulation across frames, distinct from keeping an entity alive or looping an animation.

Scene.addCompute.description: Append compute dispatches to this frame’s scene queue.

parameters.compute_commands: One or more ComputeCommand records containing pipeline, bindings and dispatch sizes.

notes: Scene.update clears the queue on its next frame. Generate recurring dispatches in an updater, and request rendering when otherwise idle. Adding commands does not directly invalidate the scene.

Scene.printTime.description: Log the current scene clock to the console in milliseconds. It neither advances time nor requests a render.

Scene.isSafari.description: Apply the current user-agent heuristic: a lowercased string must include safari and exclude chrome.
Scene.isSafari.returnsDescription: Whether that string matches the heuristic.
notes: This requires browser navigator and is not a feature-support test. Prefer testing the actual browser capability when an application needs WebGPU, codecs or audio support.

SceneComposer.isSafari.description: Apply the same browser user-agent heuristic as Scene.isSafari.
SceneComposer.isSafari.returnsDescription: True for a user-agent containing safari but not chrome; this is not proof of GPU or codec support.

VideoData.setPlaybackRate.description: Set the underlying HTML video playback multiplier, clamped between 0.0625 and 16.

parameters.rate: Playback multiplier: 1 is normal speed and 2 is twice normal speed.

notes: This changes media playback rate without seeking or changing scene.timeScale. Keep the video and scene clocks coordinated when deterministic seeking/export is required.
